title: Synchronous asset loading on GameThread
fix_rationale: Replacing hard synchronous object loads with soft object references and asynchronous loading completely avoids blocking the game loop.
evidence_template: {timer} stalled the GameThread for {ms} ms (normally {baseline_ms} ms), accounting for {share}% of the hitch duration.

fixes.text: Convert hard asset pointers (TObjectPtr, UTexture2D*, etc.) in Blueprints and C++ to soft references (TSoftObjectPtr, TSoftClassPtr).
Preload required assets asynchronously using StreamableManager or Async Loading Screen during transitions.
Inspect reference graph with Size Map / Reference Viewer to prune unexpected transitive asset dependencies.

verify: Re-trigger the asset spawn or UI opening and verify that StaticLoadObject / LoadPackage times drop to 0 ms.
caveats: Synchronous asset loading in PIE may also include compiling or disk caching costs not present in cooked builds.
